bounded_optimization_effect.why_highest_value_now: The latest concrete neuroscience slice is mechanically valid but extremely granular and queues another near-identical whitespace mutation. Its recurrence/state-robustness surface overlaps several other clean roles, while higher-value unique downstream/integration roles already run hourly and cannot be accelerated beyond hourly. A 3-hour cadence preserves CLEAN exploratory diversity while reducing low-marginal repository/tool pressure by about two thirds.
alternatives_compared: keep hourly: preserves maximum exploratory coverage but continues low-marginal churn
pause/merge immediately: larger resource reduction but insufficient evidence to justify losing all independent CLEAN coverage
repurpose prompt now: potentially higher value but conflicts with current role-config semantics and would require broader control-plane edits
reduce to every 3 hours: reversible, preserves role independence, and is the lowest-risk portfolio optimization
